text: lol all the traffic is doing loops in this one intersection [Image #1]
resolution: Same issue as req_2069 (the user's screenshot showed all traffic looping one intersection) — resolved by the goal-oriented routing rework in 63902d3f8: cars now route to distant intersections across the city instead of circling the nearest one (the old tracer closed on the smallest cycle). See req_2069 for the full write-up; the load-bearing fix was switching the routing mask from PREFERRED to DRIVABLE so crosswalk tiles at intersections stop sealing lanes off from junctions.
